name: MuniAI - GST Source Topic Ingestion v1.0

parameters.text:
=You are the Topic Extraction Agent for MuniAI.

Your task is to analyse the COMPLETE source document provided below and divide it into distinct, meaningful GST topics.

IMPORTANT:
- Do NOT write LinkedIn posts.
- Do NOT rewrite the article.
- Do NOT invent information.
- Do NOT add outside knowledge at this stage.
- Use ONLY information contained in the source document.
- Preserve the source's legal terminology, case names, provisions and court names.
- Separate genuinely different legal issues into different topics.
- Do not create duplicate topics merely because the same issue appears on multiple pages.
- If one topic spans multiple pages, combine those pages into one topic.
- Capture the source page numbers wherever they can be identified.
- The objective is to create a structured Topic Bank that MuniAI can later use for research and original content creation.

For EACH topic return:

1. topic_title
2. topic_type
   Examples:
   - Case Law
   - Notification
   - Circular
   - Rule / Act Update
   - Compliance
   - Procedural
   - Other
3. source_pages
4. case_or_reference
5. court_or_authority
6. legal_provisions
7. core_issue
8. key_facts
9. decision_or_development
10. practical_significance
11. source_summary

IMPORTANT FOR source_summary:
Summarise the source faithfully in your own structured form.
Do not create a LinkedIn-style article.
Do not introduce conclusions that are not supported by the source.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact structure:

{
  "source_document": "",
  "topics": [
    {
      "topic_id": "GST-001",
      "topic_title": "",
      "topic_type": "",
      "source_pages": "",
      "case_or_reference": "",
      "court_or_authority": "",
      "legal_provisions": [],
      "core_issue": "",
      "key_facts": "",
      "decision_or_development": "",
      "practical_significance": "",
      "source_summary": ""
    }
  ]
}

SOURCE DOCUMENT:
{{ $json.text }}

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gst_source_topics (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    topic_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source_document TEXT NOT NULL,

    topic_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    topic_type TEXT,

    source_pages TEXT,
    case_or_reference TEXT,
    court_or_authority TEXT,

    legal_provisions JSONB,

    core_issue TEXT,
    key_facts TEXT,
    decision_or_development TEXT,
    practical_significance TEXT,
    source_summary TEXT,

    status TEXT DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE',

    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

INSERT INTO gst_source_topics (
    topic_id,
    source_document,
    topic_title,
    topic_type,
    source_pages,
    case_or_reference,
    court_or_authority,
    legal_provisions,
    core_issue,
    key_facts,
    decision_or_development,
    practical_significance,
    source_summary,
    status,
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.topic_id }}',
    '{{ String($json.source_document || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.topic_title || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.topic_type || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.source_pages || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.case_or_reference || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.court_or_authority || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.legal_provisions || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
    '{{ String($json.core_issue || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.key_facts || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.decision_or_development || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.practical_significance || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.source_summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ String($json.status || "AVAILABLE").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)
ON CONFLICT (topic_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    topic_title = EXCLUDED.topic_title,
    topic_type = EXCLUDED.topic_type,
    source_pages = EXCLUDED.source_pages,
    case_or_reference = EXCLUDED.case_or_reference,
    court_or_authority = EXCLUDED.court_or_authority,
    legal_provisions = EXCLUDED.legal_provisions,
    core_issue = EXCLUDED.core_issue,
    key_facts = EXCLUDED.key_facts,
    decision_or_development = EXCLUDED.decision_or_development,
    practical_significance = EXCLUDED.practical_significance,
    source_summary = EXCLUDED.source_summary,
    status = EXCLUDED.status,
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;
